items.description: Verify function signature matches schedule_tasks(tasks: list[str], dependencies: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> list[str]
items.expected_behavior: Function accepts two parameters (tasks list and dependencies list) and returns a list of strings

items.description: Verify all tasks appear exactly once in the returned execution order
items.expected_behavior: Returned list contains each task from input exactly once with no duplicates or omissions

items.description: Verify dependency ordering is respected for all dependency pairs
items.expected_behavior: For every dependency pair (A, B), task A appears before task B in the output

items.description: Verify deterministic lexicographically largest-first selection when multiple tasks are available
items.expected_behavior: When multiple tasks have no pending dependencies, the lexicographically largest is selected first. Example: schedule_tasks(['b', 'a', 'c'], []) returns ['c', 'b', 'a']

items.description: Verify linear dependency chain is ordered correctly
items.expected_behavior: Tasks in a linear chain (A->B->C->D) are returned in dependency order

items.description: Verify diamond-shaped dependency graph is resolved correctly
items.expected_behavior: Diamond graph with tasks [a,b,c,d] and dependencies [(a,b), (a,c), (b,d), (c,d)] returns [a,b,c,d] or equivalent valid ordering

items.description: Verify multiple independent dependency chains are ordered deterministically
items.expected_behavior: Multiple independent chains are merged using lexicographic availability to ensure deterministic output

items.description: Handle empty tasks and dependencies list
items.expected_behavior: schedule_tasks([], []) returns []

items.description: Handle single task with no dependencies
items.expected_behavior: schedule_tasks(['task1'], []) returns ['task1']

items.description: Handle multiple tasks with no dependencies
items.expected_behavior: Multiple independent tasks are returned in lexicographically descending order

items.description: Raise ValueError for duplicate task names
items.expected_behavior: ValueError is raised when tasks list contains duplicate names

items.description: Raise ValueError when dependency refers to unknown task
items.expected_behavior: ValueError is raised if any task in a dependency pair does not exist in the tasks list

items.description: Raise ValueError for circular dependency
items.expected_behavior: ValueError is raised when a circular dependency exists (e.g., A->B->C->A)

items.description: Raise TypeError when tasks parameter is not a list
items.expected_behavior: TypeError is raised if tasks is not a list (e.g., tuple, string, dict)

items.description: Raise TypeError when dependencies parameter is not a list
items.expected_behavior: TypeError is raised if dependencies is not a list

items.description: Raise TypeError when task name is not a string
items.expected_behavior: TypeError is raised if any task name is not a string (e.g., int, None, list)

items.description: Raise TypeError when dependency is not a pair of strings
items.expected_behavior: TypeError is raised if any dependency is not a tuple/pair of strings

items.description: Verify task names are case-sensitive
items.expected_behavior: Tasks 'Task' and 'task' are treated as different tasks

items.description: Verify function does not execute tasks or modify external state
items.expected_behavior: Function returns ordering only without executing tasks or touching files

items.description: Verify performance meets O((N + E) log N) time complexity
items.expected_behavior: Function completes within expected time complexity for large task sets

items.description: Verify space complexity is O(N + E)
items.expected_behavior: Function uses space proportional to number of tasks and dependencies

items.description: Verify self-loop circular dependency is detected
items.expected_behavior: ValueError is raised for self-loop dependency (A, A)

items.description: Verify two-task circular dependency is detected
items.expected_behavior: ValueError is raised for two-task cycle (A->B->A)

items.description: Verify complex multi-task circular dependency is detected
items.expected_behavior: ValueError is raised for complex cycles involving multiple tasks

items.description: Verify empty dependencies list with multiple tasks
items.expected_behavior: Tasks are returned in lexicographically descending order when no dependencies exist
